card.name: Clinical Impact in interaction tables
card.fires_on: The word Impact (or Management) and the colon after it, in drug-interaction table rows that begin 'Clinical Impact:' or 'Prevention or Management:'. It also fires weakly partway through a few long medical words.

modes.label: Interaction table headings
modes.description: The word Impact or Management, or the colon after it, in a drug-interaction row following a drug class name.
modes.example: Diuretics Clinical<< Impact>>: Opioids can reduce the efficacy

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long clinical word, such as ph in meningoencephalitis or ref in refill-exchange.

card.plain: It marks the label line in a drug-interaction table where the clinical effect of the interaction is about to be described.
